addr_file.description: Path to the address configuration file containing name and address mappings for each IB endpoint.

option_file.description: Path to the option configuration file providing configurable options for the core service and default provider.

daemon_mode.description: Whether to run the service in daemon mode (-D) or as a standard process (-P).

route_preload.description: Controls preloading of GID and LID destination caches. Valid values: 'none' (default), 'full_opensm_v1'.

addr_preload.description: Controls preloading of name, IPv4, and IPv6 caches. Valid values: 'none' (default), 'acm_hosts'.

addr_data_file.description: Path to the data file used when addr_preload is set to 'acm_hosts'.

log_level.description: Log level for the ibacm service, controlling verbosity.

max_retries.description: Number of retries for resolution attempts.

resolve_timeout.description: Timeout value for resolution requests in milliseconds.

systemd_socket_activation.description: Enable systemd socket activation for the daemon's listening socket.

resolution_protocols.description: List of back-end protocols used by the default provider ibacmp for route resolution. Common values include 'sa' (Service Agent) and 'multicast'. Multicast may not work on all topologies like torus.
